Location

Grounds of Deceit, a Ferumbras' Ascension Quest area.

Behaviour

Zamulosh will become Invisible very often. It is occasionally teleported to the center of the room. Zamulosh never retreats.

Strategy

Since this boss will be found with multiple clones (5 weak and 1 equally strong), that best way to deal with it is to always attack using area damage (such as Avalanche Runes and Diamond Arrows) to hit them all. If the false Zamuloshs aren't attacked, the team will be teleported to the center of the room, forcing you to lose turns and reposition, so even if you figure out which one is the real Zamulosh, focusing on it is not recommended.

It may be difficult to keep up with the real boss' HP during the fight, but if the team is using area attacks the real Zamulosh will eventually die (and the clones also disappear when this happens).

History

  • On November 28, 2022, the Winter Update 2022 reduced its cooldown from 2 days to 1 day and 20 hours.
  • As announced on March 12, 2024, the patch raised its experience from 50,000 to 250,000 as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
  • On April 09, 2024, the patch raised its experience once again, this time from 250,000 to 500,000 as part of the 2024 Balancing Project.
